description: Changes words in a design and keeps their styles: by role (headline, eyebrow, body, cta, brand, name, date, address…), by a layer’s id or name, or by the words to find. A hidden template sample shows again once it has the person’s words. Use it for every words-only change («fix the date»). Example: { design, edits: [{ role: «headline», text: «We are\nopen» }, { find: «Saturday», text: «Sunday» }] }.

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

edits.description: each { text, and one of role, layer (a text layer’s id or name, get_design) or find (words to replace) }; e.g. [{ "role": "date", "text": "Sun 9 Nov" }]

text.description: the new words (with find: what replaces the found words)

name: edit_text
title: Edit the words
